args.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create exactly ONE transparent square anime card-game character sprite based on image 1, the NEW MASTER for this adult woman's identity and simplified hair, face, natural physique, green eyes, outfit, jewelry, fine clean linework and smooth shading. Preserve the NEW MASTER's glossy black neck-to-shoulder bob, side part, long sweeping front lock, soft inward tips and natural volume. Hair: few cohesive broad natural locks with restrained clean linework and broad shading. Keep both side sections from ears to neck organized in large flowing locks, smooth outer contour, only a few substantial tapered tips. Avoid excessive fine subdivisions, detached wiry hairs, tiny curling wisps or loops at the forehead, eyes, temples, cheeks and side-hair silhouette; do not recreate the former many-stranded hair. Keep her same refined adult face, green eyes, skin and gentle blush, black opaque sleeveless high-neck vertically ribbed top, and plain black high-waisted skirt. Preserve both delicate gold geometric oval drop earrings with horizontal bars and thin gold chain with one oval pendant. No jacket, sleeves, outerwear, new accessories or body exaggeration. Her personality is a calculating, perceptive, composed adult woman. Upright natural standing pose. True transparent background; no scenery, objects, cards, text, logo, watermark, sparkles, sweat icons or drawn effects. Frame the complete crown, all side hair, both elbows and every finger entirely INSIDE the square, with at least 8 percent clear top margin and comfortable side margins. View head through waist and upper skirt; do not crop any hand at the bottom. Keep head size and height appropriate to the existing head-to-waist series (head about 27-30 percent of canvas height), not the close-up master crop. Output 1024x1024. SIGNATURE strategist pose: slight three-quarter torso, upright head and green eyes on viewer. BOTH hands at lower chest / upper waist, corresponding fingertips lightly meeting in a small STEEPLE, palms separated. Five anatomically correct fingers per hand, delicate relaxed curves and coherent contact. One corner of mouth slightly raised in a quietly assured knowing smile; normal brows. No clasped palms or fists.
